name: Warp-based Sampling
definition: A sampling strategy where a warp of threads is responsible for only one ray in the ray-casting algorithm, rather than a warp of pixels. Color blending for the corresponding pixel is performed inside the warp of threads in parallel.
summary: Warp-based Sampling is a GPU optimization for volume ray casting that assigns one warp to one ray to align sampling with memory strides, improving cache performance over standard block-based sampling.
